=== nachforderungen ===
[project]
name = "nachforderungen"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "nachforderungen Modul der Dokumentprüfung Komponente im KI System"
authors = [
    { name = "KI Team", email = "team@ki.de" },
]
dependencies = [
    "fastapi>=0.100.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.20.0",
    "pydantic>=2.0.0",
    "python-multipart>=0.0.26",
    "python-dotenv>=1.2.2",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.0",
    "duckdb>=1.4.2",
    "requests>=2.33.0",
    "duckdb-engine>=0.17.0",
    "pandas>=2.3.2",
    "openpyxl>=3.1.5",
    "pytest-cov>=6.3.0",
    "psycopg>=3.2.10",
    "psycopg-binary>=3.2.10",
    "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=7.1.0",
    "asyncpg>=0.30.0",
    "opentelemetry-instrumentation-openai>=0.47.5",
    "exporter>=0.0.4",
    "opentelemetry-api>=1.34.0",
    "opentelemetry-sdk>=1.34.0",
    "uv>=0.11.15",
    "opentelemetry-api>=1.34.0",
    "opentelemetry-sdk>=1.34.0",
    "opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi>=0.50b0",
    "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.34.0",
    "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=7.1.0",
    "starlette>=1.3.1",
    "filelock>=3.20.3",
    "pygments>=2.20.0",
    "urllib3>=2.7.0",
    "bizlog",
    "pyjwt>=2.13.0",
    "pkg-decision-protocol",
]
requires-python = ">=3.12"

[dependency-groups]
test = [
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "faker>=37.6.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
    "pytest-cov>=6.2.1",
    "aiosqlite>=0.21.0",
    "bandit>=1.8.0",
    "httpx>=0.27.0",
]
dev = [
    { include-group = "test" },
    "pre-commit>=4.2.0",
    "mypy>=1.17.0",
    "ruff>=0.14.8",
    "pylint>=4.0.4",
    "virtualenv>=20.36.1",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 88
target-version = "py313"
extend-exclude = [
    "migrations",
    "__pycache__",
    "docs_new",
]

[tool.ruff.lint.pyupgrade]
keep-runtime-typing = true

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.12"
plugins = [
    "sqlalchemy.ext.mypy.plugin",
]
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
disallow_incomplete_defs = true
check_untyped_defs = true
disallow_untyped_decorators = true
no_implicit_optional = true
warn_redundant_casts = true
warn_unused_ignores = true
warn_no_return = true
warn_unreachable = true
strict_optional = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
testpaths = [
    "tests",
]
python_files = [
    "test_*.py",
    "*_test.py",
]
pythonpath = [
    ".",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = [
    "src",
]
data_file = ".coverage"
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/test_*",
    "*/__pycache__/*",
    "*/migrations/*",
    "*/venv/*",
    "*/env/*",
]

[tool.commitizen]
name = "cz_conventional_commits"
tag_format = "v$version"
allowed_prefixes = [
    "Merge",
    "Revert",
]

[tool.uv]
index = [
    { name = "pypi", url = "https://pypi.org/simple" },
]

[tool.uv.audit]
ignore = [
    "PYSEC-2025-112",
    "GHSA-gc5v-m9x4-r6x2",
    "GHSA-mf9w-mj56-hr94",
    "PYSEC-2026-161",
    "PYSEC-2026-248",
    "GHSA-82w8-qh3p-5jfq",
    "GHSA-86qp-5c8j-p5mr",
    "PYSEC-2026-249",
    "GHSA-wqp7-x3pw-xc5r",
    "GHSA-x746-7m8f-x49c",
    "GHSA-5239-wwwm-4pmq",
]

[tool.uv.sources.bizlog]
path = "../../03-shared-services/bizlog"

[tool.uv.sources.pkg-decision-protocol]
path = "../../03-shared-services/decision-protocol"
=== kommentar-service ===
[project]
name = "kommentar-service"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Document parsing service of the document preparation module"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "sqlalchemy>=2.0.43",
    "alembic>=1.16.5",
    "psycopg2-binary>=2.9.10",
    "uvicorn>=0.29.0",
    "fastapi>=0.111.0",
    "python-dotenv>=1.2.2",
    "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=7.1.0",
    "starlette>=1.3.1",
    "idna>=3.15",
    "mako>=1.3.11",
    "greenlet>=3.2.4",
    "bizlog",
    "click>=8.3.3",
    "asyncpg>=0.30.0",
    "pkg-decision-protocol",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    { include-group = "test" },
    "pygments>=2.20.0",
    "pre-commit>=3.0.0",
    "mypy>=1.5.1",
    "pylint>=4.0.4",
    "ruff>=0.14.11",
    "bandit>=1.8.6",
    "commitizen>=3.0.0",
    "vulture>=2.14",
]
test = [
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "pytest-mock>=3.14.1",
    "pytest-cov>=6.2.1",
    "aiosqlite>=0.21.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.2.0",
    "httpx>=0.28.1",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = [
    ".",
    "src",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
exclude = [
    "alembic",
]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.12"
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = false
ignore_missing_imports = true

[tool.commitizen]
name = "cz_conventional_commits"
tag_format = "v$version"
allowed_prefixes = [
    "Merge",
    "Revert",
]

[tool.uv]
index = [
    { name = "pypi", url = "https://pypi.org/simple" },
]

[tool.uv.sources.bizlog]
path = "../../03-shared-services/bizlog"

[tool.uv.sources.pkg-decision-protocol]
path = "../../03-shared-services/decision-protocol"

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== nachforderungen ==="; cat 02-backend/nachforderungen/pyproject.toml; echo "=== kommentar-service ==="; cat 02-backend/kommentar-service/pyproject.toml
